sentences.text: ...for the petitioner.
Mr. Madhusudan Sur, Mr. Manoranjan Mahata.
...for the State.
Learned advocate appearing for the petitioner submits that he is in custody for about 53 days and his implication in the present case is out of mere suspicion.
It has been prayed that considering the detention the petitioner may be released on any stringent condition.
Mr. Sur, learned advocate appearing for the State opposes the prayer for bail and draws the attention of the Court to the case diary.
Memorandum of Evidence was also submitted on behalf of the State, let the same be kept with the record.

I have considered the materials appearing in the case diary and the period of detention of the present petitioner and on an appreciation of the same, I am of the opinion that further detention of the petitioner is unwarranted.

As such, the petitioner, namely, Soumyajit Ghosh @ Soumajit Ghosh, be released on bail on furnishing bond of Rs. 10,000/- with two sureties of like amount each, one of whom being local to the satisfaction of the learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Baruipur.
If on bail the petitioner shall meet with the Investigating Officer of the case once in a week till further orders of this Court.

The petitioner shall inform his address/place of residence to the learned ACJM as also the Investigating Officer and any change in address should be brought to the notice of both the Soumyajit Ghosh @ Soumajit Ghosh vs The State Of West Bengal on 21 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/36618887/
1 authorities.
